title: selliguea dareiformis
intro: Selliguea dareiformis, commonly known as the 'Daun Kati' or 'Bamboo Fern', is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, alleviate rheumatic pain, and treat skin conditions such as eczema and acne, due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea dareiformis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. These bioactive compounds also contribute to the plant's potential in treating various diseases, including cancer and cardiovascular disorders.
